arch.description: Selects syscalls for the specified architecture (32 or 64). 'all' by default.

children.description: Number of child processes to spawn.

logging.description: Disable logging ('off') or specify a directory where logfiles will be placed.

dropprivs.description: If run as root, switch to nobody [EXPERIMENTAL].

seed.description: Use this number as the random seed. 0 uses system entropy.

max_syscalls.description: Do this many syscalls then exit. 0 means run indefinitely.

syscalls.description: Target specific syscalls to whitelist. If empty, all known syscalls are used.

target_syscalls.description: Target specific syscall with optional width. Format: 'syscall_name:width'.

group.description: Only run syscalls from a certain group. 'vfs' or 'vm'.

domain.description: Specify specific network domain for sockets (e.g., ipv4, ipv6).

no_domain.description: Network domains to be excluded from testing.

enable_fds.description: Enable specific fd types. Options: sockets, pipes, perf, epoll, eventfd, pseudo, timerfd, testfile, memfd, drm.

bdev.description: Block device nodes to use for destructive tests.

victims.description: Path to victim files for specific testing.

kernel_taint.description: Kernel taint flags to consider (e.g., P, W, S).

random_count.description: Pick N syscalls at random and fuzz only those. 0 means all.
